subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: A cluster of generic runtime objects and their managers: session setup/phase/event-queue flow, linked-string resource lists, hybrid file-path search lists, resource key resolution, session-mode setup dispatch, audio (Miles Sound System) integration and teardown, and small view/collision/float helpers. Boundaries among the member classes are only partially evidenced; several owners are unknown.

summary: Proposal for the generic_runtime_objects slice of Wave 2. The functions cluster into: a session director object (0x40D980 init, 0x40DA30 reset, 0x40DE60 event-queue processing) with a nested session/action-dispatch object (0x40D1B0) and a shared phase decoder (0x40CD60); a session-mode setup dispatcher (0x404B60, 0x404970) keyed on global dword_7C569C (2=race, 5=server); linked-string list infrastructure (StringList 0x404E60 and the directory-backed ResourceList 0x404D50); resource identity lookup (0x405050, 0x40BCD0) and a hybrid file-path search list (0x40A680); the audio subsystem (MilesSoundSystem 0x405D70, AudioSystem teardown 0x406E50, AudioResource release 0x405B00, stream volume control 0x406659); and a session loading context (0x411120). View camera reset (0x4064C0), a reciprocal helper (0x408420), a physics struct initializer (0x40EC70), a state/flag guard (0x404F10), and an audio commentary channel query (0x4116C0) round out the set. Ownership is largely UNKNOWN at the function-IR level, so most classes here are GUESS or DERIVED proposals, not confirmed identities.

function_roles.role: Conditional one-shot audio mixer/render setup step: gated on this+0x20 == 1 and on a positive render-fade alpha, runs short arithmetic, sets an index, and initializes the audio mixer device from the scene-name buffer with a fixed 3.0 parameter.

Session-mode setup dispatch: main-menu/bitmap reset path, race-mode state-snapshot progress accumulation that triggers RaceModeSetup at a threshold, and server-mode sound plus one-shot audio render dispatch.

Directory-backed resource list maintenance: free every node of the linked list at target+0x40 (with nested-buffer cleanup), zero the list control block, then rebuild it by enumerating directory entries through the shared string-list append helper.

Shared string-list append: allocates an owned string buffer and a 12-byte node (data, next, owned-flag), then links it as tail or as head/aux/tail of the control block at (*this)+0x40 and increments the count.
Shared state/flag guard used by menu and HUD frame paths: evaluates a packed byte field through ByteFieldExtractorWithShift and range-checks (1..2) a dword read through the register-passed object.

Resource identity resolution: maps a string to a numeric resource ID via direct name lookup, then a prefix-parsed numeric lookup, then a formatted fallback, writing the result to *a2 and returning success/failure.

Audio resource release: invokes the vtable destructor, decrements a shared resource block reference count, frees the block at zero, clears the pointer, and removes the node from a linked-list key lookup.

Open a Miles audio filter by index 0-3: resolve the filter name, enumerate Miles filters until the name matches, then open the matched filter through the config's provider handle and store index/handle/parameter.
Camera view reset: optionally closes the audio-stream handle, resets three slot entries to default (-1 identifier / 0 flag / default path string), and re-acquires a mutex.

Miles audio stream volume control: dispatches through a vtable object; on a non-zero slot+8 result applies AIL_set_stream_volume_levels to the stream, or delegates to a vtable slot+12 method when the volume is zero.

Audio subsystem teardown: walks four linked lists invoking virtual cleanup/release slots and freeing nodes, performs a virtual vtable+0x34 call, closes the wave output handle via AIL_waveOutClose, calls AIL_shutdown, and clears the active flag.
Reciprocal helper: always writes 1.0f to this+4 and writes either 1.0f/a2 or 1.0f to this+8 depending on the sign of a2.

Hybrid file-path list search: checks eight fixed entry slots then walks a variable-length array (base this+0x20, 200-byte stride, count this+0x38), comparing each entry's path string and returning the matching entry pointer.
Guarded resource lookup with optional vtable dispatch: aborts on null key or negative first-stage result, runs a second-stage computation, and when a3 is set fires the object's vtable slot at +0x10.
Session phase decoder: when the current session pointer equals the expected pointer, maps the session phase dword (0-4) identity into this+0xC; on mismatch stores fallback 5; returns this+0xC.

Session action dispatch through a three-stage cascade (menu-slot, callback, resource lookups), records the matched object, sets the dispatch flag, decodes the session phase, transitions the game-action state machine, and optionally fires the matched object's vtable slot at +16.

Global data structure initializer: initializes sub-structs at this+0x14 and this+0x4C, stores four global pointers, clears counters/indices and the head flag, sets the 0xA0 threshold and 0x94 sentinel, and returns this.

Camera director reset/init: clears flags and counters, dispatches any pending session phase, publishes the active vehicle pointer for the stored index, clears the pointer array, and ensures the sub-struct at this+0x88 exists.

Session event-queue processor running in phase 4: advances timer accumulators, iterates up to 10 queue entries, and dispatches each on action type (2 probabilistic defer/advance, 3 per-sub-type execute, 4 settle/requeue/delegate), returning the session phase.

Physics/collision struct initializer: stores a caller value, constant 5, and a caller int; sets collision inverse-mass data and six float fields; optionally runs a follow-up short computation gated on a4.

Session/loading cleanup: iterates six batches of 36-byte objects, dispatching each to mode-dependent render/physics handling and skipping batch 4-6 entries whose vehicle state is still live; returns the batch-6 count.
Audio commentary channel query: fills four out-parameters through AudioCommentaryChannelConfiguration and, on success, dispatches two vtable calls (slot 72) on the global commentary object.

classes.name: SessionSetupDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Session-mode setup dispatcher. Detects main-menu/bitmap, race (dword_7C569C == 2), and server (== 5) modes; accumulates clamped race progress against a threshold and triggers RaceModeSetup; plays a session-start sound and dispatches audio mixer setup exactly once.

classes.name: ResourceList
classes.responsibility: Directory-backed resource list. Holds a rebuild flag and a linked list of owned strings at +0x40..0x4C; frees and rebuilds the list from directory entries, delegating node insertion to StringList.

classes.name: StringList
classes.responsibility: Singly-linked list of owned strings. Control block has four dwords at +0x40..0x4C (head, tail, aux, count); nodes are 12 bytes holding a data pointer, a next pointer and an owned-flag byte.

classes.name: UIStateFlagGuard
classes.responsibility: Shared boolean state/flag guard used by menu and HUD frame paths. Reads a packed byte field via ByteFieldExtractorWithShift and range-checks a dword (1..2) read through the register-passed object; the object base is not independently verifiable.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.responsibility: Resource identity resolution and guarded lookup. Maps strings to numeric resource IDs through name lookup, prefix-parsed numeric lookup, or formatted fallback; also exposes a two-stage guarded lookup with optional vtable callback dispatch.

classes.name: MilesSoundSystem
classes.responsibility: Audio subsystem binding to the Miles Sound System (AIL). Opens and enumerates audio filters by index through the imported AIL filter surface and stores per-filter state (index, handle, provider parameter).

classes.name: ViewCameraController
classes.responsibility: Camera view slot manager. Owns an optional audio-stream handle and three per-slot entries (identifier, flag, default path string); resets them to default and re-acquires a mutex.

classes.name: MilesStreamVolumeControl
classes.responsibility: Vtable-dispatched stream volume controller in the audio subsystem. Applies per-channel volume levels through AIL_set_stream_volume_levels or delegates to a stream-control vtable slot when the volume is zero. The ecx-passed object layout is partly a decompiler artifact.

classes.name: AudioSystem
classes.responsibility: Manager for the audio subsystem lifecycle. Owns four linked lists of audio components/resources, a wave-output handle and an active flag; performs ordered teardown through virtual slots and the imported Miles shutdown surface.

classes.name: AudioResource
classes.responsibility: Ref-counted audio resource node registered in a keyed linked list. Holds a shared resource block; on release it decrements the block reference count, frees the block at zero, clears the pointer and removes itself from the key lookup.

classes.name: FilePathSearchList
classes.responsibility: Hybrid file-path list. Holds eight fixed entry slots (index 4 is skipped during search) plus a variable-length array of 200-byte path entries; searched by string comparison of each entry's path.

classes.name: SessionDirector
classes.responsibility: Central session director object. Holds the session phase/state, a nested session object, timer accumulators, a pending-phase slot, a vehicle index, and the current event queue; publishes the active vehicle pointer and processes session event queues.

classes.name: SessionActionDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Dispatches an incoming action through a three-stage cascade of lookup objects (menu-slot, callback, resource), records the matched object, decodes the session phase, transitions the game-action state machine, and optionally fires the matched object's vtable slot at +16.

classes.name: SessionPhaseDecoder
classes.responsibility: Decodes the current game-session phase. Compares the current session pointer against an expected pointer and maps the session phase dword (identity 0-4) into a stored phase, with fallback 5 on mismatch.

classes.name: SessionLoadingContext
classes.responsibility: Session/loading context holding six batches of 36-byte objects (count plus base pointer per batch). Dispatches each object to mode-dependent render/physics handling; batches 4-6 skip entries whose associated vehicle state is still live.

classes.name: ReciprocalOut
classes.responsibility: Small two-float out-struct helper: writes 1.0f at +4 and either 1.0f/a2 or 1.0f at +8 depending on the sign of a2. Likely a scratch output struct, not a real class.

classes.name: CollisionStructInitializer
classes.responsibility: Initializer for an unknown physics/collision struct: stores a caller value, a constant 5, and a caller int; sets collision inverse-mass data and six float fields; optionally runs a follow-up short computation.

classes.name: AudioCommentaryController
classes.responsibility: Global audio-commentary channel configuration object (at dword_8AC4C4). Queries channel parameters through AudioCommentaryChannelConfiguration and applies them via a vtable slot at offset 72. The canonical name 'SceneGraphQuery' does not match the audio-commentary body.

transitions.condition: reset/init sets the phase field to 1
event sub-type 12 advances the session phase to 5
null event queue entry or delegation failure sets phase -1
sub-struct allocation failure on reset marks state -1
scaled random value below entry probability; sub-type 10 runs physics init
timer expired or scaled random value at/above probability
any dispatched sub-type (2,3,4,5,6,7,10,12) advances the entry action type
conditional delegation returns false: session phase set to -1
global dword_7CD8C0 nonzero: reset progress and return
dword_7C569C == 2: snapshot/compare five state dwords, accumulate clamped progress, RaceModeSetup at threshold
dword_7C569C == 5 and sound gate set: play sound and dispatch audio render once

interfaces.name: ISessionPhaseProvider
interfaces.purpose: Contract for reading the current session phase (identity-mapped 0-4 with fallback 5) shared by per-frame consumers such as the audio controller, the random state machine, and session dispatch.

interfaces.name: IEventActionHandler
interfaces.purpose: Contract for session event-queue entries: each entry carries an action type (2 probabilistic, 3 execute, 4 settle) and a sub-type selector that drives session flow decisions.

compatibility_contracts.name: MilesSoundSystemContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The executable relies on imported Miles Sound System entry points: set_stream_volume_levels at 0x59E378, shutdown at 0x59E394, waveOutClose at 0x59E3A4, enumerate_filters at 0x59E3B0, open_filter at 0x59E3B4, and mem_free_lock at 0x59E3CC. A replacement must supply equivalent behavior or preserve the import surface.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionModeEnumContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global dword_7C569C selects session mode: 2 = race mode (snapshot/compare five state dwords, clamped progress accumulation, RaceModeSetup at threshold) and 5 = server mode (session-start sound plus one-shot audio render dispatch). A main-menu/bitmap path is gated by global dword_7CD8C0.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseDecodeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The session phase dword (session+0x4C) maps identity 0-4 onto the stored phase; when the current session pointer mismatches the expected pointer the decoder stores fallback 5. Callers rely on the returned this+0xC value.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionEventActionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Event-queue entries dispatch on action type 2/3/4 and sub-types 2-12, driving session phase transitions including advance to phase 5 (car selection) and termination at phase -1. Timing uses the global double dbl_8AFE98 accumulators and per-entry timer/delay/probability fields.

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehiclePointerContract
compatibility_contracts.description: On reset, the director publishes the active vehicle for the stored index: dword_7C54F0[index] is read and the index is written to dword_7C54DC while the pointer is written to dword_7C54E0.

unresolved: The owners of most functions are UNKNOWN at the function-IR level; the class grouping above is a DERIVED/GUESS proposal, not a confirmed identity.
flt_59E440, flt_59E450, flt_59E43C, flt_59E6E0, dword_5EA4E8, dword_5EA510 and dword_8AD298 are packet-listed globals absent from the raw decompiled bodies; their roles are unresolved.
byte_8AC494 is listed as an accessed global by 0x404B60 but does not appear in its raw source; only 0x404970 evidences it as the mixer scene-name buffer.
The 0x40D1B0 call into SessionPhaseDecode passes an uninitialized ecx-aliased register; the intended no-argument call is a DERIVED reading.

MilesStreamVolumeControl's v2+4 volume float and v2+12 stream pointer are tainted by a decompiler saved-return-address artifact, so the exact value passed to AIL_set_stream_volume_levels cannot be trusted.
The vtable slot +12 stream-control call versus the AIL_set_stream_volume_levels import path (mute vs level-set) is inferred, not documented.

Field offset 0xE4 is read through the config sub-object in 0x405D70 but packet-listed as field:this:0xE4; the exact object relationship is unresolved. Session+0x4C is likewise packet-listed as field:this:0x4C in 0x40CD60.
The five compared state dwords (obj+0x0..0x10) and the progress accumulator semantics in 0x404B60 are not established by the packet.
Semantics of the StringList aux dword (+0x48) and the node byte flag (+8) / -1 buffer prefill are unknown.
The ViewCameraReset loop touches three slots but only the first slot (this+0x1C/0x20) has field evidence; later slots are not independently evidenced.
Field this+0x34 in 0x40A680 (dword index 13) is flagged by packet facts but never referenced in the raw source.
Field obj+0x34 in 0x406E50 is a packet-listed read with no visible use in the decompiled body.
Fields this+0x28, 0x94, 0xB0, 0xB4 in 0x40DE60 do not appear in the decompiled body; their event-timing roles are unresolved.
The jump tables jpt_40CD70 (0x40CDBC) and the 0x40DF5A/0x40E006 tables (0x40E130/0x40E15C) implement the phase and event dispatches, but individual target addresses are not evidenced.
Why batches 1-3 dispatch unconditionally while batches 4-6 are vehicle-conditioned in 0x411120 is unproven; possibly distinct render vs physics object pools.
The vehicle strides 18624 and the 296-byte subrecords / 17-element state groups in 0x411120 are read-only observations from guard arithmetic, not claimed field offsets.
0x4116C0's canonical name SceneGraphQuery does not match its audio-commentary body; the mismatch is unresolved.
The sub_588410 comparison semantics (0 meaning equal) and sub_566810 prefix-check behavior are inferred from branch usage, not independently evidenced.
The audio mixer init path (0x4C85D0/0x4C8830) and the RaceModeSetup target (0x404890) are callable callees not present in this packet, so their internal contracts are out of scope.
